english: The marks of $30$ students form the following continuous frequency distribution, in which each class contains its left end point but not its right end point.

Five more students obtain the marks $x,\ 2x,\ x+8,\ 28$ and $40$, where $x$ is a real number, and the median of these five marks is $16$. These five marks are entered in the same classes. Then the median of the resulting distribution of $35$ students is
hindi: $30$ विद्यार्थियों के अंक निम्न सतत बारंबारता बंटन बनाते हैं, जिसमें प्रत्येक वर्ग में उसका बायाँ अन्त्य बिन्दु सम्मिलित है परन्तु दायाँ अन्त्य बिन्दु नहीं।

पाँच अन्य विद्यार्थी अंक $x,\ 2x,\ x+8,\ 28$ तथा $40$ प्राप्त करते हैं, जहाँ $x$ एक वास्तविक संख्या है, तथा इन पाँच अंकों की माध्यिका $16$ है। इन पाँच अंकों को उन्हीं वर्गों में सम्मिलित किया जाता है। तब $35$ विद्यार्थियों के परिणामी बंटन की माध्यिका है
solution: Median of five values is the 3rd in order, and must be $16$; $28,40\ne16$, so $x$, $2x$ or $x+8$ equals $16$
New frequencies: $5,8,10,7,5$ ($40$ goes to $[40,50)$), $N=35$, $\dfrac N2=17.5$, cumulative $5,13,23$
solution_full: The median of five observations is the third one in ascending order, so one of $x,\ 2x,\ x+8,\ 28,\ 40$ equals $16$; it cannot be $28$ or $40$.
If $x=16$: the marks are $16,32,24,28,40$, in order $16,24,28,32,40$, median $28\neq16$. Rejected.
If $2x=16$, then $x=8$; if $x+8=16$, then also $x=8$. The marks are $8,16,16,28,40$, whose median is $16$. So $x=8$.
(The median before the five students were added was $20+\dfrac{15-10}{9}\cdot10\approx25.56$.)
originality_note: New: an ungrouped set with a parameter is pinned down by its own median, and is then merged into a grouped distribution whose interpolated median is asked (way 5: median of ungrouped data feeding the median of a continuous distribution). Closest known: missing-frequency median problems. Different because: the new frequencies come from casework on an ungrouped median, not from a given total.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, the class-boundary convention is explicit where it matters, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked over all real x that x = 8 is the only solution. Changed: No change.
key_step: Casework on which of x, 2x, x+8 is the middle value, then updating the classes and interpolating.
justification: Two linked ideas: a parametric ungrouped median with a rejected case, then the grouped median of the merged data. Above the single-formula statistics anchors (2023-P1-Q15 L0, 2025-P1-Q14 L2); comparable to two-stage L3 questions such as 2024-P1-Q3.

concept_use.Median of ungrouped data: The third value of x, 2x, x+8, 28, 40 must be 16; casework gives x = 8.
concept_use.Median of a continuous frequency distrib: The median formula l + (N/2 - C) h / f on the updated table gives 24.5.
